pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, stellate and polygonal dark regions with jagged, high-frequency edge gradients. Visible patches on the lower neck are larger and more elongated than those on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a complex graph of tri-radial and quadri-radial nodes. Pathways exhibit variable pixel thickness, narrowing between closely spaced patches and widening at intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, low-amplitude serrated profile created by the mane along the upper neck and shoulder ridge, appearing as a fine, comb-like silhouette against the sky.

other_distinctive_markers: An avian organism is perched on the dorsal ridge at the base of the neck, and a second avian subject is partially visible in the frame above the upper neck.
